parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give five family members who can inherit in Islam.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain questions of inheritance according to one school of thought in Islam.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Matters of inheritance should apply equally to men and women.’ To what extent may this be
applied in Islam? Refer to one school of thought in your answer. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give five schools of thought or approaches in Islam.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain how shariah rulings are made according to one school of thought.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘There are no significant differences between the methods used by different schools of
thought.’ Do you agree? Discuss this statement with reference to two schools of thought.

Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain the teachings of al-Ashʿari about the oneness of God (tawhid) and the afterlife
(ʾakhirah).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the extent to which teachings of the Muʾtazilah about the oneness of God (tawhid)
and the afterlife (ʾakhirah) are different from al-Ashʿari. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain why the birthday of the Prophet (pbuh) might be celebrated according to some
Muslims.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Compare the views of those who do not celebrate the birthday of Muhammad (pbuh) with
those who celebrate it.
